title: Trump says he told Warsh to vote for hike with the rest of Fed board: 'It's not going to matter'
summary_full: President Donald Trump previously threatened to cut off trade with countries that have trade surpluses with the U.S. if the Fed doesn't cut interest rates.
summary_public: President Donald Trump previously threatened to cut off trade with countries that have trade surpluses with the U.S. if the Fed doesn't cut interest rates.
